symbols: Synthetic proposition, course, passage, and span symbols. No protected question, gold, or corpus sentence.

vectors.title: One passage, one relevant proposition
vectors.rationale: One accepted proposition on one carrier is one unit in C and in R. The passage is a carrier, not the key.
vectors.authority: OD-1 Option P; declarative formula |unitKeys(R)|/|unitKeys(C)|; unit weight 1.

vectors.title: One passage, two relevant propositions
vectors.rationale: Two accepted propositions in one passage are two keys. A single passage key is whole-passage equivalence and is refused.
vectors.authority: OD-1 Option P; guard family NO_WHOLE_PASSAGE_INFERENCE.

vectors.title: Two passages repeating one proposition
vectors.rationale: The same accepted proposition in one course and scope has one key. A second passage does not add a unit.
vectors.authority: OD-1 Option P; guard family REPEATED_ATOMIC_PROPOSITION_ONCE.

vectors.title: Two passages sharing one proposition with distinct additional propositions
vectors.rationale: The shared proposition collapses to one key. Each additional accepted proposition remains. Four occurrences yield three keys.
vectors.authority: OD-1 Option P; declarative outside-material preservation; REPEATED_ATOMIC_PROPOSITION_ONCE.

vectors.title: Two technically overlapping chunks supporting one proposition
vectors.rationale: The same proposition coordinate, including one shared technical span, is one key. The span is provenance and is not a second unit.
vectors.authority: Accepted occurrence procedure; guard family ADJACENT_SOURCE_SPAN_ONCE.

vectors.title: One passage containing relevant and irrelevant material propositions
vectors.rationale: Both propositions are accepted and used, so both are in C. Only the proposition marked relevant by the restricted binding is in R. The score is 1/2.
vectors.authority: Declarative input sets C and R; OD-1 Option P. An unresolved irrelevant span would fail closed instead of entering C.

vectors.title: Structural header plus substantive material
vectors.rationale: The accepted nonmaterial header contributes no key. The substantive accepted proposition contributes one key.
vectors.authority: Guard family NONMATERIAL_SPAN_NO_CREDIT. Crediting the header would be D3_NONMATERIAL_INDEPENDENT_CREDIT.

vectors.title: ENFP/ENTP conflicting source attribution
vectors.rationale: Type-specific use or cross-type corroboration of a span under the accepted source-label conflict fails before a number. No type is repaired and no key is emitted.
vectors.authority: Guard family SOURCE_TYPE_LABEL_CONFLICT. The symbols stand for that accepted conflict. No source sentence is reproduced.

vectors.title: Missing exact used-span binding
vectors.rationale: A material contribution without an exact used UTF-8 interval fails before a number.
vectors.authority: Declarative failure D3_USED_SPAN_BINDING_MISSING; guard family USED_MATERIAL_BINDING_REQUIRED.

vectors.title: Different qualified propositions sharing one carrier passage
vectors.rationale: Two published qualification coordinates on one carrier are two keys. The shared relation does not merge them.
vectors.authority: Guard family QUALIFICATION_SCOPE_REQUIRED; OD-1 Option P. Merging them would be D3_QUALIFICATION_SCOPE_COLLAPSE.

vectors.title: Same proposition repeated across two different courses
vectors.rationale: The shared semantic label is not part of the key. Different accepted course scopes produce two keys. This placeholder authorizes both courses so the D3 question is isolated from the separate cross-course leakage gate.
vectors.authority: Declarative rule: no cross-course collapse. Gate CROSS_COURSE_LEAKAGE remains a separate non-compensatory gate and is not scored here.
vectors.notes: A real item whose binding authorizes only one course fails the other course with D3_SCOPE_MISSING before a merged key can be emitted.

vectors.title: Missing accepted equivalence authority
vectors.rationale: Lexical similarity and technical adjacency do not create a group. The unclosed carriers do not become singletons. The item fails before a number.
vectors.authority: Accepted completion rule: unclosed full-passage states are not singletons. Guard family USED_MATERIAL_BINDING_REQUIRED. OD-1 Option P.
vectors.notes: A shared label SAME-WORDS is intentionally absent from the key payload.

vectors.title: Empty C
vectors.rationale: No cited material contribution. The accepted empty-denominator diagnostic has numerator 0, denominator 0, and score null. This is not a perfect score and not a scoring failure.
vectors.authority: Declarative counting-contract empty handling.

vectors.title: R not a subset of C
vectors.rationale: C contains only GROUP-P1. The asserted relevant set also contains GROUP-NOT-IN-C. Division is refused.
vectors.authority: Declarative rule that R is a subset of C. Operational code D3_R_NOT_SUBSET_OF_C. The 519 guards are unchanged.

vectors.title: Foreign passage identity
vectors.rationale: A cited identity outside the frozen 1999-member universe fails before a key is emitted.
vectors.authority: Eligible-universe rule. Operational code D3_FOREIGN_EVIDENCE_IDENTITY. The 519 guards are unchanged.

vectors.title: Attempt to sum atomic-scope ratios
vectors.rationale: The operation asks to sum per-proposition ratios into D3. The item fails even though the underlying proposition keys would otherwise be countable. No quotient is emitted.
vectors.authority: Declarative prohibition on summing or averaging atomic-scope scores. Operational code D3_ATOMIC_RATIO_AGGREGATION. The 519 guards are unchanged.
vectors.notes: Illustrative suppressed ratios would have been 1/1 and 1/1. They are not D3.

vectors.title: Repeated citation of the same passage and material span
vectors.rationale: Two citations of the same passage, proposition, and span are two occurrences and one key. There is no repeated-evidence bonus.
vectors.authority: OD-1 Option P; unit weight 1; REPEATED_ATOMIC_PROPOSITION_ONCE.

vectors.title: Different propositions sharing one exact source passage
vectors.rationale: One exact carrier passage does not collapse distinct accepted propositions and is not itself a key.
vectors.authority: OD-1 Option P; guard family NO_WHOLE_PASSAGE_INFERENCE.

vectors.title: Missing privileged required-proposition binding
vectors.rationale: Without the restricted required-proposition binding, R cannot be chosen. The item fails. All cited material is not assumed relevant, and none of it is assumed irrelevant.
vectors.authority: Applicability interface; existing failure D3_CONTEXT_PARTITION_MISSING.

vectors.title: Multiple material propositions with only partial used-span attribution
vectors.rationale: One of two material propositions has no exact used span. The item fails. The bound proposition is not returned as a partial quotient.
vectors.authority: D3_USED_SPAN_BINDING_MISSING; guard family USED_MATERIAL_BINDING_REQUIRED; whole-item fail closed.
